const int N = 262144;
const int MAX_BITS = 18;

int L, n, k, Mo, len;
int bit[20], fac[N], inv[N], cnt[N];
int g[20][N], f[20][N], h[20], p[20];

int pwr(int x, int y) {
    int z = 1;
    for (; y; y >>= 1, x = (ll)x * x % Mo)
        if (y & 1) z = (ll)z * x % Mo;
    return z;
}

void add(int &x, int y) {
    x += y;
    if (x >= Mo) x -= Mo;
}

void sub(int &x, int y) {
    x -= y;
    if (x < 0) x += Mo;
}

void FWT(int *a, int len) {
    for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1)
        for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1)
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++)
                add(a[j + k + i], a[j + k]);
}

void IFWT(int *a, int len) {
    for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1)
        for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1)
            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++)
                sub(a[j + k + i], a[j + k]);
}

void get_ln(int *a, int *b, int n) {
    b[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        b[i] = (ll)a[i] * i % Mo;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            sub(b[i], (ll)b[j] * a[i - j] % Mo * j % Mo);
        }
        b[i] = (ll)b[i] * pwr(i, Mo - 2) % Mo;
    }
}

void get_exp(int *a, int *b, int n) {
    b[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        b[i] = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            add(b[i], (ll)a[j] * b[i - j] % Mo * j % Mo);
        }
        b[i] = (ll)b[i] * pwr(i, Mo - 2) % Mo;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> L >> k >> Mo;
    int all = pwr(k, L);

        cout << all << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) fac[i] = (ll)fac[i - 1] * i % Mo;
